_comment: Example verdict file for post-thread-replies.sh. One file per finding in the verdicts directory.
body:
![Fixed](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Fixed-brightgreen)

**Re: original finding** *(severity: Important)*
> Bare `catch {}` swallows retry-fetch errors — if `doFetch()` throws during APQ retry, error is silently eaten

**Verdict:** The code is restructured so the `catch {}` now wraps **only** `clone.json()` — legitimate to ignore JSON parse failures. The APQ retry logic moved **outside** the try/catch block, so retry-fetch errors will properly propagate to the caller.
